title: Transit IHAVE/TAKETHIS path: call verify_article at ingest
description:
Wire verification into the transit peering ingest pipeline.

What: crates/transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs (the staging→IPFS pipeline)

Same pattern as W3A: after article CID is known and article is committed to IPFS, call verify_article() non-fatally. Same verify_store + dkim_resolver fields added to whatever shared state struct transit uses (PeeringShared or equivalent).

Changes mirror W3A exactly — same verify_article() function, same non-fatal pattern, same None-in-tests default.

Defensive rules: identical to W3A.
